title: StateTrace: donor- and cohort-aware validation of cellular-state transportability
description: A backend-independent Python framework for donor- and cohort-aware validation of cellular-state transportability and downstream inference in single-cell and single-nucleus datasets. It consumes the output of mapping tools (scPoli, scANVI/scArches, Symphony, Azimuth, CellTypist) and reports, per state, reproducibility across reference donors, recovery in an independent cohort, robustness to the mapping backend, shift in a frozen expression space and a transport status that gates downstream inference.
